Reasoning: This stage keeps the panda_fingertip pose fixed while grasping the marker. freeze_position enforces the stage-start panda_fingertip origin position within 0.01 m, and freeze_orientation enforces the stage-start panda_fingertip orientation within 0.05 rad. object_grasped represents closing until the marker is physically held between the fingers, stopping on grasp success rather than requiring the finger joints to reach 0.0. The API does not expose a numeric finger-joint target or bilateral finger effort/contact feedback term, and close_gripper cannot be emitted together with object_grasped, so the explicit close-to-0.0 command and contact-feedback details are represented by the object_grasped requirement and noted here.
